links.evidence: The Zensar Information Systems (IS) Service Desk serves as the central point of contact for all technical issues, hardware failures, application access requests, and infrastructure support.
Upon receiving initial temporary credentials from the Talent Acquisition or Onboarding Operations team, associates are required to perform their initial system login through this portal.

24-Hour Account Synchronization Delay Notice: For newly onboarded associates and interns, directory identity synchronization between Active Directory and ServiceNow / IS Service Desk requires up to twenty-four (24) hours following network ID creation.
